Rapfi offline Gomoku component

Source archive SHA256: 06c73fd9385c4ef65787c26e02cf20d8347b010622e33c8d0d8b543ca52ab141

The standalone engine is GPL v3; weights are CC0. COPYING.txt, AUTHORS,
WEIGHTS-CC0.txt, third-party notices, complete source archive, Android
patch and exact build recipe are bundled in this APK directory.
LLVM-RUNTIME-NOTICE.txt preserves the notices for the statically linked
NDK libc++/unwind runtime.
These notices identify this component and do not replace the application's
own license notices. Communication uses an independent Piskvork process.

Rebuilding on Windows:
1. Extract the source archive and keep android-bionic.patch beside it.
2. Obtain official NDK r30, CMake 4.4.4 and Ninja 1.13.2 using the URLs
   and SHA256 checksums in release-manifest.json.
3. In the source checkout use tools/build_rapfi_android.py; it extracts the
   pinned archive, applies the exact Bionic link patch and builds both ABIs.
   python tools/build_rapfi_android.py --prepare-tools
   A separate cache defaults to D:/DevCaches/RapfiToolchain; SDK paths and
   local.properties are neither read nor modified.
4. The included build-recipe.py is the same script. For a minimal rebuild
   create tools/build_rapfi_android.py, third_party/rapfi/the source archive,
   and the app/src/main/jniLibs target directories under one project root.
5. It links Android API26 PIE with static C++, ThinLTO and 16KiB load pages;
   arm64 uses ordinary NEON, x86_64 uses SSE4.1, with AVX/DotProd disabled.
   Only the CMake Bionic link patch is applied: pthread comes from libc,
   rather than a nonexistent separate libpthread. Engine algorithms and
   upstream weight bytes are unchanged.

Installer-extracted librapfi.so is a PIE executable, named as a native
library only for APK packaging. It is never executed from writable storage.
Data files are SHA256-verified in noBackupFilesDir before process startup.
The complete current BOARD snapshot is rebuilt for every request, with
SELF relative to the requested player. Search uses THREAD_NUM 1,
MAX_MEMORY 67108864, freestyle rule 0 and PONDERING 0.
The call deadline includes model preparation, startup and search. STOP/END,
a bounded close and a watchdog terminate cancelled/expired requests.
Runtime downloads, accounts and cloud APIs are not required.
